Craftformers: Allspark 
This is an add-on to the original Craftformers mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/craftformers-allspark

Our mod includes: 
Optimus Prime's Star Sword
Megatron's Dark Star Sword

Abilities:
Star Sword: 12 damage

Dark Star Sword: 12 damage

Mod version: 1.0.6
Languages: English/Russian

 

REQUEST: Please join our Discord channel for ideas on adding items to the game.
